blocks.text: CDM (City di Mare) officially inaugurated the CDM Link, a new pedestrian bridgeway that stands as both a vital mobility connection and a key landmark archway into Cebu City. Developed as the first pedestrian bridge along the Cebu South Coastal Road, CDM Link allows pedestrians and cyclists to move safely and conveniently between IL Corso and the rest of CDM. Yet its impact extends far beyond mobility. Rising above one of Cebu’s busiest thoroughfares, the bridgeway creates a dramatic architectural arch that transforms the experience of entering Cebu City from the south, serving as a powerful visual marker for motorists travelling […]...
